kitDescription: Arcana: Fortune Mate is a Fire shotgun Attacker (Burst II) who turns her own burst into a personal power window. Casting her burst puts her in 'Making Memories' — self Critical Rate +20.09%, Attack Damage +29.99%, a 2-round reload, and a 554.4%-of-final-ATK hit on all enemies that lands before the Full Burst window opens. While in that status her normal attacks tick a counter: every 2nd attack tops her magazine up by 6 rounds, every 4th grants 'Happy Memories' (+1 shotgun pellet, up to +3), and every 6th grants 'Precious Moments' (ATK +2.49%, up to 3 stacks); each Happy Memories application also stacks 'Snapshots of Youth' (+10% normal-attack multiplier, up to +30%). When the Full Burst ends she buffs every shotgun-wielding ally with a flat ATK grant worth 13% of HER ATK per Precious Moments stack for 15 seconds, and she strips her own Making Memories and Snapshots. Separately, casting her burst gives every OTHER shotgun ally +55% Attack Damage for 10 seconds. Net effect: a shotgun-team carry who snowballs her own pellet count and multiplier inside her burst window while paying the team back in ATK and Damage-Up.

Blind-side test-hygiene defect, not an encoding divergence (driver test pins firings(line).length === fbEnds count on afm-cast buffs).

S1-a 'reaches shotgun-wielding allies only … tgts.size === 1' — same missing casterIdx filter; the target set is polluted by other casters' casterAtkPct applies. Driver test asserts targets(line) === [afm, drake, zwei] on afm-cast events with liter (RL) excluded, which is the correct SG-typed check.

S1-a 'stack-scaled and capped at 3 stacks (13/26/39), not flat at its maximum' — two independent causes: (i) `value <= 39.001` is false because the SSOT stores casterAtkPct as an ABSOLUTE ATK grant (caster ATK × pct ≈ 46670), not a percentage — a blind-side misconception; (ii) totalOf(BASE) < totalOf(CASTER_FLAT_MAX) is false because the driver DOES bake the cap (value 39, no live stack scaling) — that half is the real, driver-DOCUMENTED ramp approximation (caveat 2, HOT direction), not an undocumented gotcha.

S1-b/c 'Snapshots … EXPIRES at FB end' (expects a buffRemove for normalAttackPct) — SSOT: buffRemove fires ONLY for reload-caused removals; a durationSec lapse emits no event. Driver models the FB-end strip as durationSec 11 lapse-reset. Blind-side event-model misconception.

burst 'Attack Damage +29.99% … and expires' (expects buffRemove for attackDamagePct) — same buffRemove-on-lapse misconception.

S2-a '2x reload 6 rounds + burst reload 2 rounds are damage: they add real shots' — the driver deliberately leaves both reloads UNMODELED (override `unmodeled.skill2`/`unmodeled.burst`, verbatim, with the COLD-direction note). Documented skip, not a silent drop.

gotchas.evidence: Kit: 'ATK ▲ 13% of the skill user's ATK x stack count of Precious Moments'. SSOT offers perResource as the live-scaling primitive (S6 blind used perResource {preciousMoments × 13}); S2b named the static read as the nearest-wrong model and asked for a ramp assertion; the S5 blind's CASTER_FLAT_MAX counterfactual is numerically identical to the shipped override, which is why that assertion went RED. Driver documents it verbatim in caveat 2 with the HOT direction.
gotchas.suggestedFix: Needs measurement before re-encoding: pin the real per-window stack trajectory from footage (read the Precious Moments pip count at each Full Burst end over 3+ rotations), then either re-key to perResource {preciousMoments × 13} if the pool primitive accepts casterAtkPct, or set an authored rampSec matched to the measured cadence. Do NOT retune the 39 to hit the board.

If they persist, move both to persistent self-buffs (or resource pools) and leave only critRatePct/attackDamagePct/normalAttackPct on the 11s window. COLD-direction correction on an already-HOT unit — do not land it as a board tune.

S5 blind modeled both as instantReload and its shot-count assertion went RED against the shipped override; S6 blind encoded fractions 0.667 and 0.222. NOT a true silent drop — both are recorded verbatim in `unmodeled` with a '~3-5 window shots, COLD direction' estimate and asserted by the driver's U1/U2 tests.
gotchas.suggestedFix: Confirm instantReload semantics in sim.ts (adds to the belt vs sets it) then encode fraction 6/9 and 2/9; the 6-round one should ideally be timed ~2 pulls into the window rather than at cast. Verify on footage that the ammo counter jumps +6 after exactly the 2nd trigger pull.

verdictRationale: Every one of the 13 kit lines is FAITHFUL (9) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (4) — faithfulness 1.0, zero UNDOCUMENTED divergences, so the three gotchas above are logged for owner visibility with documentedByDriver:true rather than as blocking findings. The S5 blind run is mechanically RED (11/7/2), and I classified all 7 REDs against the SSOT rather than taking the driver's word: three fail on the blind's own misconception that casterAtkPct stores a percentage (the SSOT states it is an absolute caster-ATK grant) compounded by a missing casterIdx filter that lets teammates' grants pollute the ordering and target-set checks; three fail because the blind expected a buffRemove on duration lapse (the SSOT states buffRemove fires only for reload-caused removals); one fails because the driver deliberately leaves both kit reloads unmodeled. Only ONE red carries substance — the CASTER_FLAT_MAX counterfactual is numerically identical to the shipped override because the driver bakes the 3-stack cap instead of scaling live — and that is exactly what caveat 2 already documents, with its HOT direction. Discrimination is sound: every load-bearing line either has an explicit counterfactual in the driver's suite (l1OneStack 3:1, targetClass, targetAll, l3NoExclude, l5AdditiveProxy, selfBuffsOnFbEnter with fixture A's zero-cast inertness, l7Half) or is pinned by a stat-name-filtered assertion that yields an empty set under its named mis-bucketing (critRatePct vs critRateNormalPct, normalAttackPct vs attackDamagePct), and every faithful block fires at the prose cadence (per own cast, or per FB end) with fixture A proving the Making-Memories family is perfectly inert across 12 team Full Bursts she did not burst into. The three-way cross-family convergence is strongest exactly where it matters: claude-fable-5 (pre-op) and claude-opus-5 (post-op override, blind) independently chose the pelletCountFlat primitive over the additive normalAttackPct proxy, corroborating the 2026-07-21 A4 fix, and both independently flagged excludeSelf as the kit's sharpest edge. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: all agents here are Claude, so the shared-prior risk is concentrated in the two items nobody could resolve from prose — whether the 2/4/6 counter CYCLES within one ~11s window (which would change the reachable stack ceiling and the whole rampSec 11 model) and whether the Happy Memories / Precious Moments pips actually persist past Full Burst end. Both need one focus recording, and both are COLD-direction refinements of a unit that is already over-modeled; they must not be tuned to hit the board reading.
